final.executive_summary: Execute a staged long in AAPL at a 0.20 target weight (~$20,000 notional, roughly 64 shares at the $311.00 signal price; actual fill at the unknown next-session open plus ~10 bps fees) — a starter, not a full position. The primary uptrend and cash-generation engine argue for owning the name, while the broken short-term tape (below the 10 EMA 318.73, VWMA 322.28 and Bollinger middle 323.72, MACD histogram widening to -3.634, bounce on shrinking 75.1M→68.0M→49.4M volume) argues against paying for full size before confirmation. Add toward 0.30-0.35 only on a close above 318.73 on volume north of ~65M with the histogram no longer making new lows; exit to zero — not trim to 0.10 — on a close below 300.00, since below that level the next visible structure is the 200 SMA at 278.86. Horizon 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the next quarterly print.
final.investment_thesis:
All three risk seats converged on the same direction — long, starter-size, rebalance — and disputed only magnitude (aggressive 0.30 with a 0.25 floor, neutral 0.15, conservative 0.10). No seat argued the franchise or the primary trend was impaired, which settles the direction; the range is where the judgment lies, and I land at 0.20 between the neutral and the Research Manager's 0.25.

What the bulls actually won. The evidence here is realized, not forecast: nine-month operating cash flow of $117.0B, above any full fiscal year in the dataset; FCF of $110.2B at a 30.2% margin; OCF/NI at 1.153x; net cash rebuilt $28.5B to $62.2B with debt down $14.4B and no new long-term debt; FQ3 gross margin of 50.06% printed in the seasonally weakest quarter; diluted EPS +28.7%; and growth that is consistent rather than a launch spike (H1 revenue +16.1%, FQ3 +16.4%). The AI strategy is capital-light — capex down 28.2% to 1.87% of revenue — not an arms race. The tape's primary structure is intact: price sits 11.5% above a rising 200 SMA at 278.86 with the golden-cross spread at 11.05%, and price below the 10 EMA and VWMA is a corrective pullback, not a trend break. The aggressive analyst's arithmetic correction also stands: 0.25 of $100,000 is ~80 shares, and eleven points on 80 shares is $880, or 0.88% of equity — not the trader's 2.6%. The nominal risk on the trader's proposed size was overstated.

Where the bears won, and why 0.25 is not the number. The conservative's rebuttal is the more honest risk framing: 0.88% prices a stop that this instrument has already shown it will jump — AAPL gapped -8.58% overnight, from 333.43 to a 304.81 open, on 132.5M shares six sessions ago. Measured to the structural line the research report itself names as trend-ending (the 200 SMA at 278.86), 80 shares carries ~$2,584, or 2.58% of equity. That is the trader's figure, correctly derived; both numbers are right about different things, and only one of them is the risk you actually underwrite on a gap-prone name in a zero-P&L account. The conservative also landed a clean technical point the trader conceded in substance: a stop at 300.00 is the single most crowded round number on the chart, sitting on the 07-31 low, with the report's defensible invalidation below 299.5 — so the exit should be framed as a close below 300, not a precise print. The neutral's synthesis is the decisive one: the MACD histogram widened from -3.521 to -3.634 on a rising day, which is acceleration of the MACD line's decline, not decay; the MACD line at +2.09 says 'not trend failure,' but 'not trend failure' is not 'buy with size.' The add trigger the aggressive analyst himself defined — a close above 318.73 on >65M shares — is an admission that confirmation is required; the same evidence standard should cap the first tranche. On volume and news the middle seat is right on both: 75.1M→68.0M→49.4M with MFI at 0.465 and price 3.5% below VWMA is an unconfirmed setup, not accumulation; and the 07-31 gap cause (record FQ3 revenue and EPS, guidance on supply constraints and memory inflation, three same-day downgrades from China Renaissance, DZ Bank and Phillip Securities, a CEO transition) is public but its duration is not priced. Three independent houses flagging component inflation for 'several more quarters' against a record 50.06% gross margin, with raw materials up 260% and days payable shortened fifteen days, is a genuine gross-margin-duration question — the report's own tripwire is sub-48.5% FQ4 margin implying a 3-5% EPS haircut. The $13.3B intangible build funded by a $13.5B rise in other noncurrent liabilities (deferred consideration, ~$2.4B/yr potential amortization) and the cash taxes falling 29% while pre-tax income rose 23% (~31% of the YoY OCF increase, flagged non-repeating) are real quality-of-earnings caveats that cap conviction.

Why 0.20 and not 0.10. The conservative's sizing is too punitive for a name 11.5% above a rising 200 SMA with $110.2B of FCF: 0.10 is closer to an observation position than an expression of the plan, and it implicitly treats a straight-line move to the 200 SMA as the base case. His 305-307 entry alternative is sensible in theory but is a limit order that is not implemented in this simulation and may never fill — if AAPL gaps through 318.73 the 'patient' entry becomes a missed trade. Why not 0.30: at 0.30 the gap-risk case is ~3.1% of equity on a first trade into a still-widening histogram, and the aggressive analyst's 'unused risk budget' argument is not an argument to fill the budget on day one. At 0.20, nominal risk to 300 is ~0.70% of equity and gap risk to the 200 SMA is ~2.06% — a real position where being wrong is survivable.

Prior lessons bind on both sides. Six AAPL Underweight/Hold calls in June-July (07-13, 07-20, 07-21, 07-22, 07-27, 07-28, 07-29) each surrendered +3.2% to +13.6% of five-day alpha by under-sizing into intact uptrends or freezing at benchmark — that is why this is not a Hold and why the starter is not 0.10. But the 07-28 and 07-29 reflections say that when a trim is anchored to a dated catalyst and an extreme multiple, the larger de-risk wins; here the dated catalyst has already printed and is public, so the asymmetry is different in kind, and the 07-24 AMZN and 07-29 GOOGL lessons — capped size near a two-sided event, wait for the trigger rather than treating a sub-ATR level as a rejection — support a modest initial tranche with a defined invalidation and no pre-committed automatic add.

What would change the call: upgrade toward 0.30-0.35 on a close above 318.73 with volume >65M and the histogram turning up, holding the 322-324 VWMA/Bollinger confluence, which opens the unfilled 329.59-333.74 gap; downgrade to zero (not 0.10) on a close below 300.00; reassess smaller if the next print shows gross margin below ~47.5%, if the ~$13B intangible/deferred-consideration transaction is disclosed as something other than licensed technology with ordinary amortization, or if guidance confirms sequential margin compression into FY2027. Stated data gaps, not papered over: the news file is 20 records of a stated 202 with essentially no coverage of 29 July-3 August and no full text, no guidance figures, gross-margin guide or price targets; there are no options-implied move, no short interest, no insider data, and no verified forward multiple — so the $334 level below is a technical gap-fill reference, not a valuation-derived target.
